newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei average closes 309.74 points lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei average closes 309.74 points lower.

text.p: Tokyo's benchmark Nikkei average closed sharply lower on Thursday due mostly to profit-taking of recent, high-flying blue chips and intermittent bouts of futures-linked selling, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 closed 309.74 points, or 1.45 percent, lower at 21,035.54. Its December futures slid 200 points to 21,120.

"On top of profit-taking in global issues, construction company shares crumbled and smaller issues including over-the-counter shares weakened, weighing down the market on a whole," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
At the end of the session, turnover stood at 316 million shares, down from 398 million on Wednesday. Decliners eclipsed gainers, 883 issues to 184, while 165 issues were unchanged.
Brokers said foreign investors, who had been leading the market higher recently, were net sellers on Thursday.
